dedupe_keys.name: dataset 31 aerpaw air to air channel sounding measurement with uavs

description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. This collection records air-to-air channel sounding with two UAVs at 3.4 GHz. One UAV acts as the centre transmitter while the receiver follows a spherical trajectory. The source describes raw SigMF I/Q samples, UAV position and heading, received power and root-mean-square delay measures. The measurements support channel models and digital twins for aerial wireless networks. DataCite binds the registered release to the AERPAW experiment. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Air-to-air wireless channel and digital-twin modelling. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
